experiment: Q3 raw detector class soft reranking
base_rationale: K4 is the existing development control that preserved the reviewed Case A continuity; Q2 changed no assignments and is reference-only.
candidate_policy: rerank only K4-eligible track candidates; do not change eligibility, gates, thresholds, dedup, surface support/fallback, assignment cardinality, or defer policy

raw_class_evidence.prior_track_distribution: confidence-weighted histogram from canonical observations assigned to the track before the current frame; one contribution per assigned observation
raw_class_evidence.agreement: prior weight for observation raw class divided by total prior class weight
raw_class_evidence.update_timing: snapshot prior class histograms before scoring a frame; score all observations against that snapshot; update only after the full frame is assigned
raw_class_evidence.deferred: no vote is added for deferred observations
raw_class_evidence.created_or_matched: canonical observation contributes after assignment for subsequent frames

parameter_search.selection_rule: Select the lambda with the highest evaluator-ID pairwise F1 among the three; ties choose the smaller lambda. Human-reviewed scores are reported separately and cannot be overridden by the evaluator metric.
parameter_search.rejection_rule: Reject if evaluator-ID false-merge tracks increase over K4, or if human-reviewed pairwise F1 decreases; if no candidate meets both constraints, keep K4.
parameter_search.test_status: all supplied caches are development; no holdout claim

known_limit: Reranking cannot recover a match that K4 made ineligible or deferred before candidate selection; Case B is not expected to be repaired by this policy.
